_comment: Sunburst collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed sunburst-solstice` (lines may be shared with other collections since #24), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_sunburst.py.

readme.title: Sunburst
looks: each line wears one look: gold and orange sun rays bursting from the chest (Victini, Nosepass, Skarmory); a sunrise from toe to head (Deerling, Mareep, Tatsugiri); molten gold with a corona of flares (Turtonator, Okidogi, Walking Wake); a sunflower with petals round a seed head (Snover, Foongus, Oricorio); black lacquer with gold art-deco sunbursts (Rotom, Seviper, Dracovish); hot tropical orange with little suns (Ditto, Nidoran M, Thundurus)
the light shimmers and the flares lick in the dark; warm glowing eyes
